title: The pod van home save point disappears for good: it despawns once the player leaves it, and no Load or Continue brings it back unless the player was sitting in it
repro: index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1&mission=m01_van. Force the mission through: GTP.game.debug.completeObjective() + advance(0.3) until Missions.state.active is null, then advance 6 s. One vehicle tagged 'podvan' is at (58,315) with persistent=false. (A) Teleport to homePoint()+(300,200), advance 40 s, teleport back to the garage door: no 'podvan' exists. (B) Sit in the van at home (the 'home' autosave fires), get out, walk 60 m, saveSlot(2), loadSlot(2): no 'podvan' anywhere. GTP.game.load() (CONTINUE) from the post-mission autosave also gives none. Reproduced on seeds 7 and 11. Scripts: tests/out/qa_d/saves/t02_podvan.js and t03_podvan2.js (SEED=11).
expected: README and h_save say the game autosaves whenever you park the pod van at home, so the van should always be parked at Gus's Garage after m01_van, including after any Load.
actual: cleanupEntities releases the m01 van (persistent=false), so the spawner despawns it. Nothing ever re-creates it: ensureVehicles has no 'podvan' entry, and applyData only respawns the vehicle the player sat in. After the first long trip or any load from a save made on foot, the home autosave can never trigger again.
hint: js/09_missions.js ensureVehicles: add ensure('podvan','pod_garage','van',{wrap:'pod',color:'#f2f2f2'}) with keep=true once m01_van is complete. cleanupEntities (around line 349) should keep the podvan persistent. js/30_game.js atHome/autosave('home') depend on it.

title: Loads ignore the saved height: a save on the Loop deck loads on the ground below it, and over the bay it drops you into the sea and the car sinks
repro: Seed 7, headless. (178,562) is a Loop deck tile over WATER; 144 deck tiles sit over water. Run spawnVehicle(178,562,'sports',{y:7}), then teleport(180,562,7) and enter the car. Advance 1 s, then saveSlot(2): the save holds y 7. Then loadSlot(2): 0.1 s later the player is swimming at y -0.94 under the Loop and the car is gone (it was spawned at sea level and sank). On a deck tile over road, (278,130), the player and car load at y 0 under the highway. Reproduced on seeds 7 and 11. Scripts: t05_deckwater.js and t04_places.js. Screenshot: deck_water_after_load.png.
expected: The player, and the car they sat in, come back where they were saved, on the deck.
actual: serialize stores data.y, but applyData calls debug.teleport(data.x, data.z) with no y, so heightAt(x,z,0) picks the ground layer. The vehicle record has no y, and spawnVehicle puts the car at ground or water level.
hint: js/30_game.js applyData: teleport(data.x, data.z, GTP.World.heightAt(data.x, data.z, data.y)). serialize: add y to the vehicle record and pass {y} to spawnVehicle.

title: The Enter that closes a menu also acts in the game on the same step: RESUME, LOAD confirm and CONTINUE with Enter throw the player out of the car
repro: Seed 7 headless, real keyboard (page.keyboard.down/up around one GTP.game.step()). Sit in a sedan. Press Escape (PAUSED, RESUME highlighted), then Enter: state is 'playing' and player.inVehicle is null. Make a save in the car (slot 2). Pause, choose LOAD GAME, slot 2, Enter, then Left and Enter on 'LOAD SLOT 2?': after the load the player stands beside the restored car. From the title, CONTINUE with Enter on that save gives the same result. Reproduced on seeds 7 and 11. Script: t20_enterleak.js.
expected: The key that resumes or loads is used up by the menu, and the player stays in the car.
actual: Enter is bound to both 'enter' and 'confirm'. UI.handleInput closes the pause menu or loads the slot, the state becomes 'playing' in the same step, and Player.control then reads pressed('enter') and calls exitVehicle. Resuming with Enter during a drive or chase bails out of the moving car.
hint: js/30_game.js step(): skip player.control on a step where _handleGlobalInput changed the state, or clear the pressed flags after a menu consumes input. The binding is in js/02_input.js BINDINGS.Enter; the exit is in js/06_entities.js Player.control. CMB-06 has the same root cause, but its symptom is firing a gun.

title: The mission autosave is written before the act or ending cutscene, so quitting or reloading during it loses cs_act2/cs_act3/cs_ending_a and the credits for good
repro: index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1&mission=m04_hit. Force the objectives through. Events: complete m04_hit at t 0.75, saved slot 1 'mission' at t 0.77, cutscene:start cs_act2 at t 3.35. The slot has no flags.cs_cs_act2. Reload the page during the cutscene, call GTP.game.load() and advance 15 s: cs_act2 never plays. m15a_primetime: the autosave is at 1.52 and cs_ending_a starts at 4.10; after a reload and Continue, neither cs_ending_a nor mission:ending/credits ever happen. m11_trustless on seed 11 does the same with cs_act3. Script: t06_actcut.js (MID=m04_hit / m15a_primetime / m11_trustless).
expected: ARCHITECTURE: the 'mission' autosave happens 'once any act cutscene is over'.
actual: _autosaveBlocked does not see the pending act cutscene (Missions pendingCut, 2.6 s delay), so the save runs at once. The queued cutscene and the ending's credits are never saved, so a player who closes the tab during them never sees them.
hint: js/30_game.js _autosaveBlocked: also block while GTP.Missions.busy() (pendingCut) or GTP.Cutscenes.active, or set _autosavePending on 'cutscene:end'. js/09_missions.js completeRun / cutsceneAfter.

title: A slot the game cannot read (another version's save, a truncated write) is shown as 'Corrupt save', cannot be deleted, and NEW GAME overwrites it without asking
repro: Seed 7 headless. Write slot 1 with version 4 (the format the v0.3 story track introduces) and money 77777, then setState('title'). The title shows no CONTINUE. The LOAD GAME card reads 'Corrupt save. Context stamped.' with only NEW GAME HERE: there is no DELETE button and the Delete key does nothing. NEW GAME + Enter starts at once in slot 1 and overwrites it (money 250, version 3), with no OVERWRITE prompt. Repeated with a v3 slot 1 truncated by 40 chars: overwritten the same way. Scripts: t28_misc.js (part 3), t29_misc2.js, t31_corruptcard.js. Screenshot: corrupt_card_load.png.
expected: An unreadable slot is treated as occupied: an OVERWRITE confirmation, a DELETE option, and a label that tells another version's save apart from damage.
actual: slots() marks any non-v3 or unparsable slot as empty:true, so NEW GAME's 'no save anywhere' path, titleSlotActivate('new') and slotCards all treat it as free space. A newer-version save opened in this build is destroyed silently.
hint: js/30_game.js slots(): keep empty:false for corrupt slots, or add an 'unreadable' state. js/11_ui.js titleActivate('play') (the `any` test), titleSlotActivate('new') and slotCards: confirm before overwriting a corrupt slot and offer DELETE. Consider keeping a backup key.

title: Pause-menu SAVE during a non-mission cutscene marks it as watched: the save skips the rest of the act or ending cutscene and the credits
repro: ?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m15a_primetime. Finish the objectives, wait for cs_ending_a (the player is placed on the tower roof, y 60.9), then Escape, SAVE, slot 2, Enter. It saves with no prompt; the save has flags.cs_cs_ending_a=true and y 60.92. loadSlot(2): no cutscene and no credits. The ending can never be seen from this save. Seed 11 with m04_hit and cs_act2: same, the cutscene never plays after loading. Script: t07_cutsave.js (MID=m15a_primetime, then MID=m04_hit SEED=11).
expected: Either SAVE is unavailable while a cutscene plays, or the save resumes after the cutscene with it still unseen.
actual: openPause accepts 'cutscene' and doSave's busyText only checks missions and strands. Cutscenes.playOnce sets flags['cs_'+id] when the cutscene starts, so the saved flags say it was watched.
hint: js/11_ui.js doSave / pauseSlotActivate: treat Cutscenes.active (or Missions.busy()) as busy, or grey out SAVE. js/12_cutscenes.js playOnce: set the flag in finish(true) instead of at start.

title: Deleting the migrated slot 1 does not stick: the old v2 save is migrated back on every boot, and CONTINUE stays on the title after every slot is deleted
repro: Write a hand-written gtp.save.v2 (money 3456, six completed missions) and reload: slot 1 is migrated. Call GTP.game.deleteSlot(1) (or DELETE in LOAD GAME): every slot is empty but hasSave() is still true, so the title keeps CONTINUE. Reload the page: slot 1 is back (migrated:true, $3,456). Reproduced on seeds 7 and 11. Script: t09_legacy.js.
expected: A deleted save stays deleted. Migration happens once, and with no slots there is no CONTINUE.
actual: migrateLegacySave runs on every boot whenever slot 1 is empty and never marks the old key as migrated. hasSave() also returns true while gtp.save.v2 exists.
hint: js/30_game.js migrateLegacySave: write a 'gtp.save.v2.migrated' marker (or rename the key) after a successful migration and skip it after that. hasSave() and load() should ignore a legacy key that was already migrated.

title: Pause-menu SAVE works at any wanted level and in a burning car: loading clears the stars, and a burning car comes back either still burning or fully repaired
repro: Seed 7: debug.setWanted(n) for n=1..5 and advance 2 s (11-13 cops on the player). Pause, SAVE, slot 3: it saves with no prompt and the card shows n stars. loadSlot(3) gives wanted 0 and AI.wanted.level 0 at every level. Burning car: applyDamage(9999) to the player's sedan (burning, hp -9899), then pause SAVE. Loading puts the player back in the burning car, which explodes (player hp 100 to 65). A car at exactly hp 0 (burning) loads at hp 100. Scripts: t21_wanted.js (all five levels), t24_burning.js, t08_midmission.js (m06_rally escape_wanted).
expected: No manual save while wanted or in a burning vehicle (GTA rule; autosave already refuses these). Or the save restores the same state.
actual: Save then load is a free 5-star clear and a free car repair. The slot card's stars do not match what loads.
hint: js/11_ui.js doSave: refuse with a toast while player.wanted>0, inVehicle.burning, or !alive (reuse GTP.game._autosaveBlocked). js/30_game.js serialize writes vehicle.hp<=0 and applyData's `if (sv.hp)` skips 0.

title: A slot that passes the card check but fails to apply wipes the running game, and can leave the player at NaN coordinates
repro: In game (money 9999, at (300,300)), write slot 3 as a version-3 save with missing fields: {version:3,seed:7}, or the real save with x/z removed, or with completed:'m00_intro'. The slot card shows it as a normal save. loadSlot(3) returns false and toasts 'Could not load the save', but the session is already replaced: money 0 or 250, the player at spawn, or at x/z null (NaN) with the error 'load: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading isVector3)'. From the title, CONTINUE then toasts 'No save to continue; starting new'. Script: t10_corrupt.js (variants v3_minimal, v3_no_pos, v3_completed_string).
expected: A load that fails leaves the current game untouched, and malformed slots are flagged before anything is torn down.
actual: _loadData calls newGame(data.seed) before applyData, with no validation and no rollback.
hint: js/30_game.js loadSlot/_loadData: validate the decoded save first (finite x/z, an array for completed, objects for weapons and flags). Only then call newGame. slots() should apply the same check so the card shows it as unreadable.

title: Loading a save made in a rampage bubble starts the rampage again at once; with QA-STR-06/07, each save and load doubles the loaner ammo
repro: Seed 11: fists only. Teleport 20 m from the rr_04 bubble, then onto it (+0.5 m) and advance 1 s: the rampage runs (SMG 120). Pause, SAVE slot 2 (this ends the rampage). loadSlot(2): within 1.5 s the rampage is running again and the SMG has 240. Each further save and load gives 480, then 960. Seed 7 with rr_02: after the load the rampage is active and the pistol goes 100 to 160. Scripts: t28_misc.js (part 1), t19_strandsave.js.
expected: Like the mission lights, a bubble arms only after the player has stepped out of it. A completed bubble's cooldown survives a load.
actual: rebuildMarkers creates every rampage marker with armed:true and cooldown 0 on load, so pollMarkers starts the rampage after K.startHold. Cooldowns are not saved.
hint: js/09_missions.js rebuildMarkers/pollMarkers: start rampage markers unarmed when the player is inside (as mission markers do), and save mk.cooldown in Strands.serialize.

title: SAVE mid-mission aborts the mission but keeps its loaner weapons, so shop-locked guns can be farmed by restart and save
repro: ?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m12b_scope: after the equip objective (Fact Checker +10), pause SAVE and confirm 'Saving now will abandon the mission'. The save keeps sniper:10 while the shop still locks the sniper ('Citation Needed') until m12b is complete. m09b_hotmic at its destroy objective keeps hotmic:4. Seed 11 m13b_ratio keeps ratio:6 (about $3,600). Each restart and save adds another load. Scripts: t08_midmission.js, t28_misc.js (part 2).
expected: Abandoning a mission, by ABORT or by SAVE, takes back what its equip objectives issued.
actual: teardownRun only restores weapons for replays (weaponsBefore is null on normal runs), and run.equipped is never used on abort or fail.
hint: js/09_missions.js newRun/teardownRun: snapshot weapons at start (or use run.equipped) and remove the loaners on abort, fail or quit. js/11_ui.js doSave calls Ms.abort().

title: Two tabs on the same save silently overwrite each other's progress
repro: One browser context with two tabs, both on slot 1 ($1000). Tab A completes m00_intro (autosave slot 1: completed [m00_intro], $1100). Tab B then picks up a memo (strand-cycle autosave to slot 1): slot 1 now has completed [] and $1000, and A's Continue has lost m00. Seed 11 variant: A saves $9000 plus a rifle to slot 2; B finishes m00 and its autosave overwrites slot 2 ($600, no rifle). Scripts: t12_twopages.js and t29_misc2.js.
expected: A tab does not autosave over a newer save written by another tab: it skips with a toast, or offers to reload.
actual: saveSlot writes blindly. Nothing listens to the 'storage' event or compares savedAt.
hint: js/30_game.js saveSlot/autosave: remember the savedAt this page last read or wrote per slot. If the stored one is newer, skip the autosave and toast. Optionally listen for window 'storage'.

title: With the tab hidden, the car engine and police siren keep sounding at full level while the game is frozen (no pause or mute on visibilitychange)
repro: Live page (headless=0, mute=0, --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required): the player drives a sedan with two siren-on cop cars nearby. Emulate a background tab: rAF callbacks held, document.hidden true and a visibilitychange event. Output RMS (an analyser on the destination) stays at 0.11-0.15 for the whole 60 s, while game time stays frozen at 0.62 s. With the radio stopped, the engine and siren loops alone hold 0.14-0.15 for 30 s. Scripts: t17_hidden.js and t17b_hidden.js.
expected: Hiding the tab pauses the game and silences its loops (GTA pauses when minimized). Resuming restores them.
actual: The engine, siren and heli loops are continuous oscillators updated only from Audio.update inside Game.step. When rAF stops they hold their last gain indefinitely. The visibilitychange handler only resets _last.
hint: js/30_game.js boot visibilitychange: on hidden, open the pause menu and ramp GTP.Audio's loops/master to 0 (or ctx.suspend()); resume on visible. js/03_audio.js updateEngine/updateSiren/updateHeli.

title: No pause during the ratio war or the debate: Escape, P and M do nothing, so you cannot pause, mute, save or quit
repro: ?headless=1&seed=7&mission=m03_ratio, and again with mission=m14_grift. Tap confirm until state is 'minigame' (ratio, debate). Real keys Escape, KeyP and KeyM: the state stays 'minigame' each time. Script: t26_minigame_pause.js. Screenshot: minigame_esc_m14_grift.png.
expected: Pause works in every state where the player has control, as in GTA minigames.
actual: UI.handleInput case 'minigame' swallows every key, and openPause only accepts 'playing' or 'cutscene'.
hint: js/11_ui.js handleInput 'minigame': on pressed('pause') call openPause (allow 'minigame' in openPause; closePause restores ui.pause.from). js/30_game.js step only ticks the minigame in 'minigame', so pausing freezes it correctly.

title: After a load the camera always faces north instead of behind the player
repro: Seed 7: set player.yaw = PI and Render.rig.yaw = PI (facing south), saveSlot(2), loadSlot(2), advance 0.5 s. Player yaw is 3.14 but Render.rig.yaw is 0, so the camera looks at Bryce's face (camyaw_180.png). With yaw PI/2: player 1.57, rig 0. Script: t30_camyaw.js.
expected: The chase camera sits behind the player after Load or Continue.
actual: newGame sets rig.yaw to the fresh player's yaw (0). applyData sets p.yaw afterwards and only calls rig.snap().
hint: js/30_game.js applyData: set GTP.Render.rig.yaw = p.yaw (or the vehicle's yaw) before GTP.Render.rig.snap().

title: Loading a save made in the sponsor van or THE RATIO duplicates it: one copy at its bay and one under the player
repro: Seed 7: mark m00..m02_read complete, set flags.race_car, then Strands.load(...) so the sponsor van is at the depot (254,415) and the ratio car at the garage (58,318). Enter each, teleport 150 m away, saveSlot(2), loadSlot(2). Two 'sponsorvan' exist (the depot and 404,455 with the player) and two 'ratiocar' (the garage and 208,358). Script: t22_dupvan.js.
expected: One sponsor van and one THE RATIO, where the player left them.
actual: applyData runs the SaveHooks first: Strands.load calls ensureVehicles, which sees no live tagged van and spawns one at the bay. Then the saved vehicle is spawned under the player as well.
hint: js/30_game.js applyData: restore the saved vehicle before the SaveHooks (ensure() then finds it), or skip spawning strand-owned tags and move the ensured one under the player.

title: A migrated v2 save shows no district or landmark on its card, and starts at 0 subscribers despite its completed missions
repro: Hand-written gtp.save.v2 with six completed story missions, then reload. Slot 1 meta has district null and landmark null, so the card reads 'Grievance City' with no landmark. After CONTINUE, player.subs is 0 and the tier is 'Pre-Viral', where the six missions' rewards x5 would have given subscribers. Reproduced on seeds 7 and 11. Script: t09_legacy.js.
expected: The card shows where the save is, like any v3 slot, and subscribers are credited for the completed missions (the story pays reward x5 subs).
actual: migrateLegacySave runs in boot() before newGame generates the world, so _summary's districtAt and landmarks return nothing. upgradeLegacy hard-codes subs: 0.
hint: js/30_game.js boot: migrate after newGame (or rebuild summary lazily in slots()). upgradeLegacy: subs = sum(reward of completed) * Missions.K.subsPerReward.

title: The title menu parses every slot three times per frame: with 1.5 MB saves one title frame takes 633 ms
repro: Seed 7: write three valid v3 saves of 1.5 MB each (a large flags object; they fit the quota). g.slots() takes 206 ms, one title-menu UI.draw takes 633 ms (slots() runs 3 times per frame through hasSave, latestSlot and slots), and the LOAD page 212 ms per frame. Normal 1 KB saves take 0.04 ms. Script: t13_oversize.js.
expected: Slot metadata is read once and refreshed when a slot changes.
actual: Every frame on the title and slot pages, all three slots are JSON-decoded three times.
hint: js/11_ui.js titleItems/slotCards and js/30_game.js slots(): cache the result and invalidate on 'saved', 'save:deleted', 'save:migrated' and 'storage' events.

title: Ped geometry cache never evicts: JS heap grows about 10 MB a minute and renderer geometries go from 170 to 1,723 in 20 minutes of play
repro: Headless index.html?headless=1&seed=7&skipTitle=1. Prebuild every chunk first with GTP.Render.prebuild(448,448,2000) so chunk building does not affect the numbers. Then play 40 mixed 30 s segments: driving with radio and horn, wanted 1-5 chases, explosions and thrown weapons, deaths, busts, mission prep/abort, races and rampages, shop buys and weapon cycling, on-foot fights, teleports. Script: PREBUILD=1 node tests/out/qa_d/soak.js 40 7 b (log soak_b.log, data soak_b.json). After each segment, call window.gc() (Chromium with --js-flags=--expose-gc), then read performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize and GTP.Render.renderer.info.memory.geometries. To find the source: tests/out/qa_d/origin.js wraps BufferGeometry.setAttribute to record creation stacks. tests/out/qa_d/heapcount.js counts live objects per prototype with CDP Runtime.queryObjects. Seed 11, driving only: node heapcount.js 5 11 traffic.
expected: With entity counts flat, heap and GPU geometry count level off once the chunks are built. Any per-look cache is bounded (LRU with dispose) or uses shared part geometry.
actual: Seed 7 soak: heap 72.6 MB at boot, then 137.6 / 193.6 / 239.4 / 278.5 MB at about 5 / 10 / 15 / 20.5 min. Renderer geometries go 170, 849, 1220, 1397, 1723. Over the same run, live entities stay at 202-288, unique geometries in the scene stay at about 1,300, there are no errors and no NaN values. Live BufferGeometry objects go from 1,319 to 5,054 in 232 s while Mesh objects stay at about 2,400. Of 3,442 orphaned geometries (alive, not in the scene, never disposed), about 3,440 come from pedGeo (05_assets.js:1010): head (pedParts :930) 1,828, torso (:893) 1,033, arms (:914) 570. After 6 mission cycles their typed arrays alone hold 64 MB. Seed 11, driving only: heap 71 MB to 182 MB and BufferGeometry 1,332 to 4,993 in 200 s of game time. The key space is about 89,658 head and 3,420 torso combinations, so for practical purposes it never stops growing. A long session, especially on a phone, runs out of memory.
hint: js/05_assets.js pedGeo / pedGeoCache (a Map keyed by skin|hair|hairColor|hat|glasses|extra..., never evicted or disposed). Cap it as an LRU and call geometry.dispose() when an entry leaves, or build parts from a few shared geometries and tint by vertex colour or material. Note for the models track: 05d_models.js replaces pedParts in v0.3 and must not copy this pattern.

title: Switching to another tab leaves the engine drone, siren wail and radio playing forever (no suspend or pause on visibilitychange)
repro: Non-headless index.html?seed=7&skipTitle=1&low=1. Click the canvas to unlock audio. Spawn a sedan on the nearest road point and enter it, hold forward, and spawn a cop car with siren=true 12 m away. An AnalyserNode on the destination reads rms 0.18. Bring a second tab to the front (Playwright page2.bringToFront()): GTP.game.frames stops (7, then 7 again 1.5 s later) but rms stays 0.185. Simulated hidden tab: override document.hidden / visibilityState, dispatch visibilitychange and cancelAnimationFrame(GTP.game._raf), as browsers stop rAF in hidden tabs. Then listen at +1, +3 and +6 s. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/audio2.js hidden 7 (and 11).
expected: When the page is hidden (or on pagehide or blur), the game pauses and the audio is suspended or faded (ctx.suspend(), or bus gains to 0). It comes back on visible.
actual: At +1 / +3 / +6 s with 0 frames rendered: AudioContext 'running', Audio.state() engine.on true, siren.active true (gain 0.64), radio playing. Analyser rms 0.20 / 0.20 / 0.19 on seed 7 and 0.202 / 0.203 / 0.194 on seed 11. The engine, siren and heli loops are continuous oscillators whose gains only move inside Audio.update, which runs from Game.step on rAF. They keep their last level for as long as the tab is hidden, and the game does not pause either.
hint: js/03_audio.js has no visibilitychange / pagehide handling. js/30_game.js boot() only resets _last and _acc on visibilitychange. Add a document visibilitychange (and pagehide) listener that calls ctx.suspend() (resume on visible, as unlock() already does) and opens the pause menu (UI.openPause) when the page hides while playing.

title: Roadblock cruisers keep their siren wailing and lightbar flashing forever after the stars are gone
repro: Non-headless seed 7, unlock audio, freeze rAF. Teleport to World.nearestRoadPoint(200,448), enter a sports car, debug.setWanted(3) and hold forward until AI.police.roadblocks.length > 0 (about 3 s). Stop the car and call GTP.AI.wanted.clear() (evading or a respray clears it the same way). Advance 5 s, then 25 s more. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/siren2.js 7 roadblock (and 11). Screenshot: tests/out/qa_d/roadblock_siren_after_stars.png.
expected: When wanted drops to 0, every police vehicle turns its siren off (pursuit cruisers already do), so the siren loop stops.
actual: Seed 7: at +5 s and +30 s the roadblock cruiser (ai.kind 'cop', ai.mode 'parked', no driver, 81 m away) still has siren=true. Audio.state().siren is active with count 1 and gain 0.10-0.11, and the analyser reads rms 0.077-0.084 at +30 s with 0 stars on the HUD. Seed 11: same, gain 0.10 and rms 0.066 at +30 s. It wails until the car despawns at 220 m.
hint: js/07_ai.js updateRoadblocks: on release the cars get ai.kind='cop', ai.mode='parked' but keep siren=true and lights=true. AI.update skips vehicles with ai.mode 'parked' or no driver, so copCarTick's `v.siren = false` never runs. Clear siren (and lights) on release when wanted.level is 0, or turn off sirens on all police vehicles in a 'wanted' level-0 listener. Cruisers whose cops got out (copsExit sets 'parked') can follow the same path.

title: The first 5-star helicopter adds a SpotLight to the scene: every lit material recompiles and that frame takes 3.3-3.5 s (16 ms normally)
repro: Headless seed 7: teleport (578,214), GTP.game.render() twice (programs 20, 16 ms). debug.setWanted(5) and advance in 0.5 s steps until GTP.AI.police.heli exists, then time one GTP.game.render(). Count scene lights by type. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/programs.js 7 (and 11).
expected: No shader recompile when the helicopter arrives. Per ARCHITECTURE, unused lights sit at intensity 0 so the light count never changes.
actual: Spot lights in the scene go from 7 to 8. renderer.info.programs goes 20 to 36 (seed 11: 20 to 37). The first frame with the helicopter takes 3,500 ms (seed 11: 3,296 ms) against 9-16 ms before and after. On a real GPU this is a visible stall at the 5-star moment. Later helicopters reuse the cached programs. This is the same class of bug as CMB-04 (the muzzle light) but a separate trigger.
hint: js/07_ai.js Heli.buildMesh creates `new THREE.SpotLight(...)` per helicopter, and Entities.add puts it in the scene. Keep one resident spotlight in Render.lights (js/10_render.js, intensity 0 when no helicopter) that the helicopter drives, or put the helicopter light in the existing spots[] pool.

title: An AI racer whose car is wrecked leaves its driver as a permanent persistent ped (frozen, or a corpse that never fades); they pile up with every race
repro: Headless seed 7, low=1. Spawn a sports car at Strands.races.def('lr_01').startPt, enter it, Strands.start('loop_races','lr_01'), advance 4 s, then hold forward 8 s. Set racer 1 on fire (Strands.races.cur.racers[0].v.applyDamage(hp+5, player, 'pistol')) and advance 6 s; the driver bails out. Call Strands.end('quit') and advance 3 s. Repeat 4 times, then teleport about 700 m away and advance 5 s. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/racedrv.js 4 7 explode (and 3 11 explode). With 'quit' or 'exit' alone (no wreck), nothing leaks.
expected: Race cleanup removes or releases every ped the race spawned, or turns them back into ordinary non-persistent peds that despawn.
actual: After each race the bailed-out driver stays in Entities.list with persistent=true and ai.mission 'driver'. That brain is never ticked, so the ped stands frozen on the course. Seed 7: 1, 2, 4, 5 such peds after rounds 1-4, two of them dead corpses (hp 0) that never fade. Seed 11: 1, 2, 4. All are still in the entity list 700 m away. The count grows with every race where a racer is wrecked.
hint: js/09_missions.js drivers.take sets `v.driver.persistent = true`, and drivers.release never resets it. races.end only removes `rc.v.driver`, which is null once the driver has left the car. Track the spawned driver on the racer (rc.drv) and remove it in races.end, or clear driver.persistent in release(). HOA targets and rampage cars use drivers.take too.

title: Cutscene score never plays on foot: cs_act2, cs_twist and cs_ending_a ('music: station:<id>') are silent
repro: Non-headless index.html?seed=11&skipTitle=1&low=1. Click to unlock, freeze rAF. Standing at (578,214), call GTP.game.debug.playCutscene('cs_act2') and advance 2.5 s, then read Audio.radio.state() and the analyser. Repeat with cs_twist and cs_ending_a, and once each from inside a car. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/csmusic.js 11 (and 7).
expected: A cutscene whose script says music 'station:pennant_fm' or 'station:quiet_signal' plays that station's music for the cinematic (GDD_EXPANSION 4.x; 12_cutscenes musicStart).
actual: On foot: the station switches (radio id 'pennant_fm' / 'quiet_signal') but radio.playing is false, level 0, live false and rms 0 for all three. Seed 7 cs_act2 is the same. In a car cs_act2 does play (rms 0.039). cs_twist and cs_ending_a move the player out of the car, so they are silent even when started from a car. The act-change and ending cinematics have no audio.
hint: js/03_audio.js updateRadio: inCar = p.inVehicle && (playing|cutscene); the sequencer only runs in a vehicle. js/12_cutscenes.js musicStart only calls radio.setStation. Add a 'score' mode, for example Audio.radio.force(true) while Cutscenes.active with a station spec, that runs the sequencer without the vehicle check and without the car-speaker filter.

title: A gamepad-only player never hears anything: only key, mouse and touch create the AudioContext
repro: Chromium with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required (Electron's default policy). Use page.addInitScript to stub navigator.getGamepads with a standard pad. Open index.html?headless=0&skipTitle=0&seed=7&low=1 and dispatch 'gamepadconnected'. Press only pad A (button 0) on the title until play starts, then enter a car with pad Y. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/pad.js 7 (and 11).
expected: Pad input also unlocks audio (Input._gesture, then Audio.unlock), at least where autoplay is allowed (the desktop build), and the first pad press on the title starts the sound.
actual: Seeds 7 and 11: state 'playing', Input.lastDevice 'gamepad', in the car, radio logically playing, but GTP.Audio.ctx is null and unlocked is false for the whole session. A single keyboard press (Shift) then creates the context ('running').
hint: js/02_input.js pad polling sets lastGesture but never calls _gesture() / GTP.Audio.unlock(). Call Audio.unlock() when a pad button is newly pressed. The desktop build could also create the context at boot.

title: Every hot take and hot mic thrown leaks one GPU geometry (never disposed)
repro: Headless seed 7, low=1. Disable ambient spawning (GTP.AI.spawner.update = () => {}) and teleport to (578,214) with god mode. For each of 'hottake' and 'hotmic': give 10, tap shoot 5 times (2 s apart, 3.4 s for the mic), and render every 2 steps as live play does. Read renderer.info.memory.geometries. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/proj.js 7, and proj2.js 11.
expected: renderer.info.memory.geometries returns to its earlier value once the projectiles are gone.
actual: Exactly +1 geometry per throw. Seed 7: hot take 188 to 193, hot mic 195 to 200. Seed 11: 145 to 150 and 152 to 157. projectilesLeft is 0. The launcher's sphere is usually swapped before its first render (+0.2 per rocket).
hint: js/10_render.js buildEntityMesh makes `new THREE.SphereGeometry(...)` for every projectile, and Render.detach does not dispose it. js/08_combat.js skinProjectile swaps e.mesh.geometry without disposing the sphere. js/05b_assets_weapons.js weaponMesh('hotmic') builds a new CylinderGeometry cap and a cloned material each call. Share one sphere geometry (it is cached for the material already) and dispose own geometries in detach.

title: The helicopter rotor goes silent the instant the stars clear, while the helicopter is still overhead flying away
repro: Non-headless seed 7, unlock audio, freeze rAF. debug.setWanted(5) and advance until AI.police.heli orbits within 40 m: Audio.state().heli gain 0.65, rms 0.12-0.19. Call GTP.AI.wanted.clear() and sample at +1, +3 and +6 s. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/heli.js 7 (and 11).
expected: The rotor fades with distance as the helicopter leaves; it is visible for about 9 s.
actual: At +1 s the helicopter is 21-24 m away and 38-39 m up (leaving) but Audio heli gain is 0. At +3 s it is 29-57 m away, gain 0, rms 0.006. At +6 s the loop has stopped while the helicopter is still in the sky (seeds 7 and 11).
hint: js/07_ai.js Heli.leave() calls Audio.heli(false), and update() then keeps calling Audio.heli(!this.leaving) = false. Keep calling Audio.heli(true, x, z) while leaving (spatial() already handles the distance) and only stop when it is destroyed or shot down.

title: Settings MUSIC slider says 'the radio and the title theme', but there is no title theme: the title screen is silent
repro: Non-headless index.html?headless=0&skipTitle=0&seed=7&low=1. Press Shift on the title (this unlocks audio; ctx 'running') and listen 3 s with an AnalyserNode on the destination. Read GTP.UI.settingRows.find(r=>r.id==='music').note. Script: node tests/out/qa_d/title.js 7 (and 11). grep -n theme js/03_audio.js finds nothing.
expected: Either a title theme plays and the MUSIC slider controls it, or the note only mentions the radio.
actual: rms 0, peak 0 and Audio.counts {} on the title for both seeds. The settings row still promises a title theme.
hint: js/11_ui.js SETTING_ROWS music note (line 229), or add a title-screen sequencer in js/03_audio.js (for example a station pattern on the music bus while state is 'title').
